title: SteerTrace: Tracing How Target Attacks Steer World Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.25719v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World action models (WAMs) predict future videos and actions with one backbone, and their imagined future is often seen as a safety signal. We introduce SteerTrace, a targeted universal attack on WAMs that also traces its effect inside the model. One $\ell_\infty$-bounded (4/255) perturbation per model, shared across frames, tasks, and camera views, pushes the executed action toward an attacker-chosen target. On eight WAMs from four families (FastWAM, Faster-WAM, OpenWAM and LingBot-VA) on LIBERO and RoboTwin, it drives task success close to zero and moves the attacked action toward the target. Same-budget noise and BadWAM produce little action shift in the target direction. We use the signed targeted effect to measure how much of the effect each intervention removes or reproduces. translated_title: SteerTrace：追踪目标攻击如何操纵世界动作模型
translated_abstract: 世界动作模型（WAM）通过单一骨干网络同时预测未来视频和动作，其“想象的未来”常被视为一种安全信号。我们提出了SteerTrace，这是一种针对WAM的定向通用攻击方法，同时还能追踪攻击在模型内部产生的影响。每个模型仅需一个ℓ∞范数约束（4/255）的扰动，且该扰动跨帧、跨任务、跨相机视角共享，即可将模型执行的动作推向攻击者选定的目标。在来自四个模型家族（FastWAM、Faster-WAM、OpenWAM和LingBot-VA）的八个WAM上，基于LIBERO和RoboTwin基准测试，该攻击使任务成功率降至接近零，并将受攻击的动作推向目标方向；而相同预算的随机噪声和BadWAM在目标方向上仅产生很小的动作偏移。我们利用带符号的定向效应来衡量每种干预手段消除或重现了多少攻击影响。在标准攻击下，恢复未来token（future tokens）可以在五个动作专家关注未来token的模型中消除61-94%的定向攻击效应。当……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出SteerTrace——首个针对世界动作模型的定向通用攻击方法，仅需一个跨帧、任务和视角共享的微小扰动即可将机器人动作推向攻击者目标、使任务成功率接近零，并通过追踪内部效应发现恢复未来token可消除61-94%的定向攻击影响。
en_tdlr: SteerTrace is a targeted universal attack on world action models that uses a single perturbation shared across frames, tasks, and views to steer robot actions toward attacker-chosen targets, while tracing its internal effect and showing that restoring future tokens removes 61-94% of the targeted attack effect.
